question: Oliver Kell warns 'exhaustion extension' far above the 50DMA is late; on four_pct 4%-up days, expect higher dist_50dma (more extended above 50DMA) to be WORSE (lower avg stop-R) than being close to the 50DMA.
plain: Oliver Kell says buying a stock that already ran way above its 50-day average is dangerous overextension; this checks whether 4%-up days far above the 50DMA do worse than ones closer to it.
